messages:
maria_g: Heads-up — vendor just notified a 10–14 day delay on the EU H100 allocation. They offered a split-shipment option (partial air) for urgent reserved units. This will impact Dedicated onboarding next week. Anyone able to quickly estimate cost/throughput delta? :frowning:

josh_ops: Ugh. How many units are we talking?

kai_sourcing: Vendor says ~40 of 120 are delayed. 20 can be air-exported in ~3 days but at ~+$1,200/unit. The remaining ~20 are sea/customs ~12 days. Also mentioned RMA return labels will be on separate AWB.

olivia_vendor: Sorry for the disruption — backlog at the fab caused the hold. We can prioritize air for customer-allocated reserved units. I'll push AWB + provisional proforma for air charges. Can you share a serial manifest for priority marking?

maria_g: I'll assemble serials for the Dedicated batch. Quick Q: will there be any SLA credit for deliveries >7d late?

olivia_vendor: We can offer a 10% procurement invoice credit for delays >7 days, or waive expedite fees for the first 15 units shipped by air. Need legal/contact to sign a short amendment.

anna_logistics: For RMA logistics — vendor, can you confirm whether RMA AWBs are consolidated or per-customer? Customs HS code variance might slow re-import.

olivia_vendor: RMA AWBs will be per-customer but we consolidate manifests at our hub. HS code will be 8471.80; we'll attach an insurance addendum. For EU re-imports we'll include RA (return authorization) docs to speed customs.

josh_ops: If those 40 EU H100s are out, what's the impact on Dedicated throughput? We need mitigation (burst to cloud / throttle tenants).

maria_g: Losing 40 EU H100s drops Dedicated throughput ~35% for the region. Short-term mitigation: throttle non-critical tenants, move latency-sensitive workloads to US pool + burst credits.

kai_sourcing: Vendor also flagged a potential DOA rate bump to ~2.2% on high-stress shipments. We should push them to cover DOA for air shipments.

olivia_vendor: We will cover DOA for air shipments if reported within 7 days of delivery; will provide this in writing.

maria_g: Please send written confirmation and the AWB + credit note PDF. Also need a clear invoice line for expedite fees vs capital procurement.

olivia_vendor: Will send the credit note and AWBs by EOD UTC. Uploading provisional manifest now:

```
vendor_manifest.csv
serial,model,customer,allocation_priority
SN100001,H100,redwood-dedicated-01,high
SN100002,H100,redwood-dedicated-02,high
SN100003,H100,redwood-burst-01,medium
SN100004,H100,redwood-burst-02,medium
...
```

anna_logistics: Got the manifest. I'll validate HS codes and the insurance slip. For RMA: please provide return label PDFs per customer and include FRA depot address for repair intake (FRA-DEPOT-12).

olivia_vendor: Confirmed — RMA labels per-customer as PDFs; pickup scheduled 3–5 days after arrival; hub consolidation for transit claims.

josh_ops: Also request cost comparison: air procurement vs cloud-bursting (public cloud GPUs). Finance, can you run a quick delta?

kai_sourcing: Looping in @simon_finance for delta and accounting treatment.

simon_finance: On it. Quick Q: what currency are expedite charges quoted in and are they capitalizable?

maria_g: Expedite fees are ops (non-capex). Procurement base cost is capitalizable. Tag charges to project "dedicated-eu-onboard" and we'll break out expedite line items.

simon_finance: Got it — will produce a short table by CET lunchtime.

olivia_vendor: Sending docs now, CC'ing legal. We will prioritize the 20 air units to redwood-dedicated-01/02. Apologies for the schedule risk.

maria_g: Thanks. Please CC legal for the amendment. Also cc procurement for the credit note acceptance.

kai_sourcing: Next steps: 1) vendor posts AWB + credit note, 2) Maria publishes serial list and confirms priority mapping, 3) Anna validates RMA paperwork + HS code, 4) Simon runs cost delta and confirms op vs capex treatment. I'll track this on the procurement board.

maria_g: Thanks all :thumbsup:

vendor-bot: Document uploaded: proforma_1728809999.pdf (link)
